verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no product-native way to configure recurring or triggered automations that run autonomously in the background. The async callback URL [deepgram-docs-11] only delivers results for a single request, and CLI exit codes for scripts and CI [deepgram-docs-20] are building blocks a user would wire into their own scheduler. The voice agent API is a real-time conversational runtime, not a background automation system, so none of these count toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
